summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM过程中温度与应力场分布，优化热电材料SnTe的加工参数。
summary_zh.method: 使用有限元法模拟SLM逐层熔凝过程的热力耦合场。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了温度梯度与残余应力分布规律，为工艺优化提供依据。
summary_zh.validation: 通过文献数据对比验证模拟结果的合理性。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the temperature and stress fields during selective laser melting of thermoelectric SnTe to optimize the process parameters.
summary_en.method: A finite element model was developed to simulate the coupled thermo-mechanical behavior during layer-by-layer melting and solidification.
summary_en.result: The distributions of temperature gradient and residual stress were identified, providing guidance for process optimization.
summary_en.validation: Simulation results were validated against literature data on melt pool dimensions and residual stresses.

papers.title: The effect of precautions on early dislocations post total hip arthroplasty: a retrospective cohort study
papers.abstract: Introduction: The efficacy of hip precautions in preventing dislocation post total hip arthroplasty (THA) has been questioned in recent literature. From 2014 our centre ceased routinely prescribing them due to lack of evidence. We investigate the effect of stopping these precautions on dislocation rate, patient satisfaction and Oxford hip score (OHS). Methods: Patients who underwent primary total hip arthroplasty prior to this change in protocol ( n = 2551) and for 1 year subsequently ( n = 673) were identified. Operative records were used to identify key demographic and operative data. Incidence of dislocation, OHS and patient satisfaction were extracted from the centre’s electronic database. Subset analysis of those patients dislocating within 6 weeks was performed. Results: Rate of dislocation at 6 weeks in those prescribed and not prescribed precautions was 0.71% and 0.89% respectively ( p = 0.618). At 1 year this rose to 1.25% and 1.49% ( p = 0.406). Satisfaction ( p = 0.332) and OHS ( p = 0.441) at 1 year was not significantly different between cohorts. Conclusions: Cessation of prescribing routine hip precautions post primary THA does not appear to significantly affect overall dislocation rate, patient satisfaction or functional status at 1 year post-operatively.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为临床回顾性研究，不涉及髋关节生物力学建模或植入物力学分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical cohort study on dislocation rates after THA; it contains no biomechanical modeling, FEA, stress shielding, micromotion, or implant interface mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估停止常规髋关节预防措施对全髋置换术后脱位率的影响。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性队列研究，比较2014年前后两组患者的脱位率、满意度和牛津髋关节评分。
summary_zh.result: 停止预防措施后，6周及1年脱位率无显著差异，患者满意度和功能评分也无显著变化。
summary_zh.validation: 基于电子病历和手术记录的大样本回顾性数据分析。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate whether discontinuing routine hip precautions after primary total hip arthroplasty affects dislocation rates and patient-reported outcomes.
summary_en.method: A retrospective cohort study comparing dislocation rates, Oxford hip scores, and satisfaction in patients before and after a protocol change that ceased prescribing hip precautions.
summary_en.result: No significant differences in dislocation rates at 6 weeks or 1 year, nor in satisfaction or OHS, were observed between the precaution and no-precaution groups.
summary_en.validation: Clinical data from electronic medical records and operative notes for 3224 patients were analyzed statistically.

papers.title: Design and characterization of trabecular structures for an anti-icing sandwich panel produced by additive manufacturing
papers.abstract: The need for a high-efficiency hot air anti-icing system is met by the use of sandwich panels with high surface area trabecular structures as core. Trabecular structures have good mechanical properties and are able to act as thermal exchange and structural support. A structural characterization of complex trabecular structures made by Additive Manufacturing is required. For this study, AlSi10Mg specimens were produced by Selective Laser Melting technology varying cell shapes (with or without vertical struts), cell sizes (4 and 5 mm) and struts size (1 and 1.2 mm). Compressive tests were performed on the specimens and fracture mechanisms for the two cell types were analyzed by optical microscope observation. The rupture modes of the specimens are strongly dependent on the cell shape as shown by the mechanical results and confirmed by comparison with the Gibson–Ashby model.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究防冰夹芯面板的支柱结构，与生物医学植入物设计无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on anti-icing sandwich panels using AlSi10Mg alloy, with no biomedical context, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, and no osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 需要高效防冰夹芯板，采用支柱结构芯层。
summary_zh.method: 选区激光熔化制造AlSi10Mg试样，变化单元形状和尺寸，进行压缩测试。
summary_zh.result: 断裂模式强烈依赖于单元形状。

summary_en.motivation: High-efficiency anti-icing sandwich panels require core structures with both thermal exchange and mechanical support.
summary_en.method: AlSi10Mg trabecular specimens with varying cell shapes and sizes were fabricated via selective laser melting and tested under compression.
summary_en.result: Fracture mechanisms are strongly dependent on cell shape, as confirmed by mechanical testing and Gibson-Ashby model comparison.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compressive test results were validated against the Gibson-Ashby theoretical model.
